intent.summary: Accepts and edits textual user input bound to application state.
useWhen: Users must enter or modify text
avoidWhen: The value comes from a small closed set better represented by a choice control

semantics.childPolicy: no visual children; label and supporting text are associated peers
semantics.sizing: minimum interactive target with content-driven or parent-constrained width
semantics.ordering: text follows locale and input-method rules

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Persistent accessible purpose of the field.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Transient example or hint; never the only label.

attributes.name: contentType
attributes.description: Semantic input purpose used for keyboard, autofill, and validation hints.

attributes.name: readOnly
attributes.description: Whether editing is disabled while selection remains available.

constraints.message: Every text input requires a persistent accessible label.

accessibility.focusBehavior: focusable and editable unless disabled or read-only
notes: Expose required, invalid, protected, and help states when applicable.

mappings.strategy: Capture binding, label, prompt, content purpose, and multiline policy.
Select control from contentType and multiline semantics.
caveats: PasswordBox binding behavior differs from TextBox.
